recap: Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 35 points (8-25 FG, 4-13 3PT), 9 rebounds and 1 assists.
Tyrese Haliburton led the Pacers with 31 points (10-15 FG, 6-10 3PT), 6 rebounds and 8 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: ball security, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 43.9 to 59.1.

Bench points: CLE 26, IND 21. Points in the paint: 50–44. Second-chance points: 13–6.
